author: teteumac
body:
Remove the `CaloSETInpHF` and `CaloSETInmHF` histograms from METTester, including their member declarations, initialization, booking and filling. Also remove the two local values used exclusively for these
  fills.

  The removal applies to all CaloMET collections and directories using the tester, including HLT configurations. Reconstruction and event selection are unchanged.

  Validation: `git diff --check` passed, and no references to the removed histograms remain in METTester.cc or METTester.h. Compilation, package tests and the RelVal execution chain were not rerun for this
  revision.
title: [RelVal] Remove HF SET histograms from METTester - Round 1
